enums.name: DriftWindowSize
enums.documentation: Rolling windows over which drift statistics are maintained.

enums.name: ModelStatus

values.name: PASSED
values.documentation: Passed the A/B gate, eligible for activation.

values.name: REJECTED
values.documentation: Failed the A/B gate; retained for audit, never served.

values.name: ACTIVE
values.documentation: Currently serving traffic. At most one row may hold this status.

values.name: ARCHIVED
values.documentation: Previously active, superseded by a newer version.

enums.documentation: Lifecycle of a registered model version.

enums.name: TrainingJobStatus
enums.documentation: Lifecycle of an asynchronous fine-tuning job.

enums.name: TrainingTrigger
enums.documentation: Why a training job was created.

models.name: Document

fields.name: externalId
fields.documentation: Caller-supplied natural key. Stable across re-ingestion of the same document.

fields.name: idempotencyKey
fields.documentation: Deduplication key for exactly-once consumption. Unique across the whole stream.

fields.name: source
fields.documentation: Originating system, e.g. "support-tickets" or "product-catalog".

fields.name: occurredAt
fields.documentation: Event time as reported by the producer, not ingestion time.

fields.name: contentHash
fields.documentation: SHA-256 of `text`, hex encoded. Used for corpus dedup and eval reproducibility.

fields.name: objectKey
fields.documentation: MinIO object key holding the raw ingested payload. Null until the upload lands.

models.documentation: A document submitted by a client system, before embedding.

models.name: Embedding

fields.name: modelVersionId
fields.documentation:
Null only for embeddings produced by the un-tuned base model before any
version was registered.

fields.name: dimension
fields.documentation: Denormalised for cheap validation; must equal 384 for the MiniLM family.

models.documentation: The 384-dimensional embedding of a document, produced by a specific model version.

models.name: DriftWindow

fields.name: klDivergence
fields.documentation: Divergence measures against `baseline`. Null until enough samples accumulate.

fields.name: driftScore
fields.documentation: Normalised composite score in [0, 1].

fields.name: threshold
fields.documentation: Threshold in force when this window was scored, captured for auditability.

fields.name: baselineId
fields.documentation: The window this one was compared against. Null for baseline windows themselves.

models.documentation: An aggregated drift measurement over one time window.

models.name: ModelVersion

fields.name: version
fields.documentation: Human-facing identifier, e.g. "2026.07.26-1". Immutable once created.

fields.name: baseModel
fields.documentation: Hugging Face id of the model this version was adapted from.

fields.name: artifactUri
fields.documentation: MinIO URI of the exported ONNX artifact.

fields.name: artifactSha256
fields.documentation: SHA-256 of the artifact, hex encoded. Verified on load before serving.

fields.name: loraRank
fields.documentation: LoRA rank used for this adapter. Null for the base model.

fields.name: metrics
fields.documentation: Eval results for this version, e.g. { "mrr": 0.71, "recall_at_5": 0.83 }.

fields.name: baselineMetrics
fields.documentation: The same metric shape for the version this one was gated against.

fields.name: improvementPct
fields.documentation: Relative MRR improvement over baseline, as a fraction. Gate requires > 0.10.

models.documentation: An entry in the model registry.

fields.name: driftWindowId
fields.documentation: The drift window that triggered this job. Null for MANUAL and SCHEDULED runs.

fields.name: modelVersionId
fields.documentation: The version this job produced. Null until training succeeds.

fields.name: hyperparameters
fields.documentation: Full hyperparameter set, captured so a run can be reproduced exactly.

fields.name: sampleCount
fields.documentation: Number of documents sampled into the training set.

fields.name: error
fields.documentation: Failure message from the final attempt. Null unless status is FAILED.

fields.name: lossHistory
fields.documentation: Per-step loss, streamed to the dashboard: [{ "step": 1, "loss": 0.42 }, ...].
